Seeker two-column execution dashboard: the right column has four cards (tasks / operation panel / sub-agents / artifacts) with memory pinned at the bottom. The left column keeps only a one-line status card, plus thinking cards and Q&A cards embedded in the conversation stream (font size follows the official “Settings → Font Size”). The message body can render cards: html sandbox (runs real HTML/JS), diagram flowcharts, iu native interactive cards, and proto-tabs. Also included: conversation screenshots, a download tool, bare-path-to-link conversion, a provider center (API Key / network proxy / image generation, image recognition, video generation / AnySearch, entry on the official settings “Providers” page), and six workbenches: memory / soul / capabilities / usage / gallery / mailbox.
